static_traits.name: Lin Anqi
static_traits.occupation: Dentistry student currently studying(Learning to become a dentist)
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends and classmates,but has not yet shared this thinking pattern with them;relationships with friends somewhat tense due to Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;no similar psychological issues before;no prior psychotherapy or counseling history
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly with coherent logic;negative and worried tone,often using absolute statements(such as 'I will never succeed in my life');noticeable self-reproach and 'should' phrasing;skeptical about Intervention but willing to try,highly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: I keep having one thought:my late-sleep habit will hinder my future success,this thought makes me feel pressure and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I found this thinking pattern is affecting my ability to focus on studying and affecting my overall mental health.
growth_experiences: The belief 'staying up late leads to failure' formed during Bachelor's degree:at that time often staying up late for Learning,while frequently exposed to the social message 'successful people all get up early',gradually equating late nights with failure;as licensing Exams approaching,this view Reinforced,Anxiety and self-doubt worsen,sleep and physical-mental state affected.

core_beliefs: I am destined to fail (staying up late = failure)
Success depends on meeting the social standard of 'early to bed and early to rise'

special_situations.event: At bedtime at night lying down Reflection on the day,the moment of preparing to fall asleep
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I stay up late again today,it means I lack self-discipline,and will not succeed in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces themselves to adjust their routine, tries relaxation techniques, repeatedly thinks and self-blames in bed to seek a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Because I stayed up late again,I will never succeed in my life

special_situations.event: Licensing Exams approaching,the day's Academic pressure heavy or the day going poorly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If today's state is poor or pressure is high and I still stay up late,then it proves I will not pass the exam,with no future prospects
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles effort and self-pressure, plans a strict schedule, avoids seeking help from others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Stayed up late again this time,my exam and future are all ruined

special_situations.event: Hearing or recalling social information and evaluations that 'successful people get up early'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not go to bed early and get up early,I do not deserve success and will be looked down upon
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to conform to external norms, demands of himself with 'should/must', and avoids mentioning staying up late to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should go to bed early and get up early,otherwise I am not good enough and do not deserve success

special_situations.event: Noticing Relationship tension or worsening Anxiety when interacting with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not maintained an ideal schedule,worsened relationships are my fault
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces talking with friends about real distress; avoids sharing to avoid negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must be disappointed in me; the worsening relationships are all because of me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and succeed,while hoping to be accepted even with a different schedule
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged as lacking self-discipline and not good enough,fear of failure and Being rejected
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and security by internalizing social standards and self-berating
Reduces the risk of being evaluated through self-restraint and avoiding seeking help

object_relations.self_representation: A self lacking self-discipline and liable to fail at any time

object_relations.object_representation: Friends / others who easily look down on and pick at her

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on normative topics such as 'success standards/early rising', or when asked about daily routine and self-discipline
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying the counselor or others will judge oneself as lacking self-discipline and not good enough(transference:Projecting social judgment onto the counseling relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Objective tone,emphasizing 'society all says so',listing facts and reasoning,avoiding emotional vocabulary like shame and Anxiety as much as possible.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share distress and support systems (friends/classmates) or express needs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If troubles are exposed, being looked down on or feeling embarrassed
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Answers are short and vague, quickly turns back to 'I will handle it myself', avoiding unfolding inner experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to do behavioral experiments,facing uncertain outcomes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Once the outcome is not ideal it proves oneself hopeless
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Raising multiple 'buts',emphasizing experiments may be ineffective,downplaying the meaning and value of trying with rational reasons.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about friends' Relationship tension and self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing Relationship tension to one's own flaws and late-sleep behavior
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Frequently use 'It is all my fault' expressions,self-blaming tone,reducing exploration of situational multi-factors.

manifestations: Places one's own choices and routine under social norms ('successful people all get up early')
Constrains oneself with 'should / must', forming conditions of worth
Equating 'staying up late' with 'life failure' at bedtime,experiencing despair of 'I will never succeed in my life'
outcomes: Impaired concentration in Sleep and Learning
Avoids seeking help; social support is hard to convert into a sense of meaning

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes the creed that 'successful people all get up early', demands of oneself with 'should/must'
Equating late nights with failure without examining its truth

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward others or to seek help outwardly from others, turning the energy toward themselves; corresponds to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Having supportive friends and classmates but unwilling to share troubles out of embarrassment
Self-pressure and self-blame rather than seeking external support

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial(such as 'I will never succeed in my life')
Excessive caution and tension,worrying about being judged as lacking self-discipline

positive_force: Having supportive classmates and friend resources(though not yet used,but available)
Having clear awareness of the distress,able to describe triggering situations and impacts
Willing to try behavioral experiments; has motivation to change
No major physical illness,energy and schedule can be adjusted
negative_force: Internalizing the rigid belief that 'getting up early = success' and dependence on external evaluation
The high-pressure situation of the Approaching exam Reinforcing Anxiety
Bedtime rumination and self-reproach leading to Sleep impaired
Shame and embarrassment blocking help-seeking and use of Social support

target_behavior.behavior: Bedtime anxious rumination and 'late night=doomed to fail' automatic thinking
antecedent: Lies down at night ready to sleep and reviews the day
Nearing a licensing exam or under heavy same-day pressure
Encounters social messages such as 'successful people all get up early'
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjecting social norms as self-worth standards,accompanied by cognitive biases of catastrophizing,all-or-nothing and overgeneralization to pursue control and certainty
target_behavior.function: Gaining false control and avoiding the Anxiety of uncertainty and being evaluated in the short term through self-blame and rumination
target_behavior.consequence: Rising Anxiety,Sleep impaired,next-day focus and Declining academic performance,Interpersonal tension
